items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: Benny Powell, what a great man. I was in the big, the best band.

ctx.x: I’ve been doing some reading. What was that like?

Wonderful. Being with Basie man, was, I wish I could have afforded to stay in that band. He and I talked and financially, he couldn’t pay me what I wanted. But that was like being the Vice President of the United States. Benny Powell, what a great man. I was in the big, the best band.
